sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Chandra Prakash Purohit - Advocate for the applica  Shri Virendra Khadav - G.A. appearing on behalf of Advo  ORDER 1.
They are heard.
Perused the case diary/challan papers.

2. This is the applicant's first application under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973), as he / she is implicated in connection with Crime No.347/2023 registered at Police Station Bistan, District Khargone (MP) for offence punishable under Section Section 363, 366, 376, 376(2)(n), 343 of IPC, and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act and 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SCST Act.
The applicant is lodged in jail since 16/12/2023.
3. Allegation against the applicant is of abduction and rape.

4. Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the prosecutrix was a consenting party and she has resided with the applicant for around 4-5 days, which is also reflected from her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C./183 of BNSS, and the age of the prosecutrix is also in dispute and she has also not stated that the applicant had forced himself on her.

It is further submitted that the charge NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:24908 2 MCRC-35149-2025 sheet has already been filed, applicant is in jail since 16/12/2023 and the final conclusion of trial is likely to take sufficient long time.

Hence, it is submitted that the bail application be allowed and applicant be Parvej @ Tingu vs State Of M P Through P S Bistan Distt ... on 4 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/188684200/
1 released on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Counsel for the respondent / State, on the other hand has opposed the prayer and it is submitted that no case for grant of bail is made out.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary, this Court finds force in the submissions as advanced by the counsel for the applicant, and further taking note of the fact that the age of the prosecutrix is in dispute, applicant is lodged in jail since 16/12/2023, and final conclusion of the trial is likely to take sufficient long time, in the considered opinion of this Court,
the applicant's application deserves to be allowed.
7.
Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application filed by the applicant is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on bail upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his/her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he / she shall remain present before the court concerned during trial and shall also abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437 (3) Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.
8. M.Cr.C. stands allowed.
(SUBODH ABHYANKAR) JUDGE krjoshi Parvej @ Tingu vs State Of M P Through P S Bistan Distt ... on 4 September, 2025
